item.title: Microsoft Debuts MAI Cyber 2 Flash Security Model at 2% Cost
item.description:
Microsoft released MAI Cyber 2 Flash, a dedicated cybersecurity model that edges out GPT-6 Astra on the CyberGym-E2E benchmark with a 92.3% task success rate versus 91.5%, at under 2% of the per-task cost. It features a 1M-token context window, four times its predecessor, and will be exclusive to Microsoft security products, auto-replacing existing MAI configurations from mid-December.

原文标题：微软发布 MAI Cyber 2 Flash 网安模型 成本仅 2%

Why it matters：专用安全模型以极低成本逼近前沿通用模型，对企业安全 AI 的选型与成本结构有直接参考价值。

item.title: Sensei Shrinks AI Agent Output to One-Tap Decisions on Wearables
item.description:
Sensei launched a cross-device generative experience spanning Ray-Ban Meta glasses, Apple Watch, iPhone, iPad, web and a Mac app. Its core idea is to let build, merge and deploy agents handle the long-running work while pushing only the prepared action to the wrist, where users approve, reject or defer it.

原文标题：Sensei 将 AI 智能体输出压缩为腕上单次决策

Why it matters：展示了智能体交互从长文本输出向可穿戴设备单点决策收敛的产品方向。

item.title: Nvidia Reaffirms Open-Source AI Strategy and $12.9B Hugging Face Deal
item.description:
Interim CEO Collette Kress used Nvidia's first earnings call since Jensen Huang's resignation to reaffirm the company's open-source AI commitment, saying the $12.9 billion Hugging Face acquisition remains on track. She cited a 35-fold year-over-year surge in weekly token volume on OpenRouter as evidence that open models are accelerating adoption, and noted Nemotron is now the most widely used U.S. open model on the platform.

原文标题：英伟达重申开源 AI 战略不变 129 亿美元收购 Hugging Face 照常推进

Why it matters：黄仁勋离职后英伟达首次公开定调开源路线，叠加 129 亿美元收购 Hugging Face 的进展，是观察其 AI 生态战略走向的关键信号。

item.title: Microsoft MAI Image 2.7 Tops Image Editing Leaderboard at One-Fifth the Cost
item.description:
Microsoft released MAI Image 2.7 and MAI Image 2.7 Flash, two image generation and editing models focused on localized edits that preserve the rest of the frame and maintain visual consistency across successive modifications, with transparent-background output. Microsoft says MAI Image 2.7 tops the Artificial Analysis image editing leaderboard at 1215 points, four ahead of GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst, at roughly $35 per thousand images, about one-fifth the cost. Both models are in public preview on Microsoft Foundry, with Flash at about $10 per thousand images powering the interactive Canvas workspace.

原文标题：微软 MAI Image 2.7 登顶图像编辑榜 成本仅对手五分之一

Why it matters：头部厂商在图像编辑赛道以榜单第一加五分之一成本正面挑战 OpenAI，价格与能力双维度都值得关注。

item.title: Prime Radiant Open Sources External Sandbox Pattern for Coding Agents
item.description:
Simon Willison and AI research lab Prime Radiant introduced the external sandbox pattern, in which the coding agent runs outside a dedicated sandbox while the code it executes is isolated inside it, reducing the risk of damaging actions from local model mistakes or prompt injection. They released three open-source sandbox server implementations, including one running Alpine Linux in WebAssembly via v86 and one using Apple Containers.

原文标题：Prime Radiant 开源编码智能体外置沙箱方案

Why it matters：为编码智能体提供可复用的安全隔离范式与开源实现，直接回应提示注入与本地模型试错风险。

item.title: Google Adds Gemini Privacy Control to Keep Chats Out of AI Training
item.description:
Google updated Gemini's app controls so users can keep chat history while opting out of using it for generative AI model training, with adjustable retention periods and manual review or deletion. If the new history setting is off, chats are still retained for about two months to deliver responses, handle feedback and protect safety.

原文标题：谷歌更新 Gemini 隐私控制 聊天记录可免于训练

Why it matters：主流大模型产品在数据训练与隐私控制上的策略调整，涉及用户数据使用边界。

item.title: Microsoft Launches MAI Code 2 Coding Model at 5% of Claude Opus 5.5 Cost
item.description:
Microsoft unveiled its in-house coding models MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash at Ignite 2026, now live in GitHub Copilot. Microsoft claims Code 2 averages about 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol's performance across four coding benchmarks at $0.309 per task, roughly 5% of Claude Opus 5.5's cost, while the lightweight Flash scores a 61.0% average pass rate on DeepSWE 1.1, Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE Atlas, beating GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5.

原文标题：微软发布 MAI Code 2 编程模型 成本仅为 Claude Opus 5.5 的 5%

Why it matters：微软自研编程模型以极低成本对标头部竞品，直接改变 Copilot 生态的模型选择与成本结构。

item.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with 20% Price Cut
item.description:
OpenAI introduced GPT-6.2 Astra, a frontier model for the hardest projects, and GPT-6.2 Sol, an efficient model for everyday work, both available via API as gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol. Astra is priced at $8/MTok input and $40/MTok output, 20% below the previous 6 Astra, with cached input dropping to $0.40/million versus $1/million, a major boon for long-running agentic sessions; Sol holds at $2/$10.

原文标题：OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol 双模型，输入降价 20%

Why it matters：OpenAI 新一代双模型发布并伴随主力模型降价与缓存大幅折扣，直接影响开发者选型与智能体成本结构。

item.title: Amazon and Google to Own Nearly 30% of Anthropic After IPO
item.description:
Anthropic's IPO filing reveals Amazon will hold roughly 14.7% in non-voting shares, with Google holding a similar stake, putting the two cloud providers at nearly 30% combined. Amazon converted promissory notes priced at about $2.09 to $5.05 per share, while Anthropic has committed to spending over $100 billion on cloud services over the next decade.

原文标题：Anthropic IPO 后亚马逊与谷歌合计持股近 30%

Why it matters：头部大模型公司 IPO 股权结构首次清晰，云厂商深度绑定的资本与算力关系值得关注。

item.title: OpenAI Unveils GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol Ahead of Anthropic IPO
item.description:
OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol one day before Anthropic's IPO pricing, targeting professional work, coding, computer use and multi-step agentic tasks while cutting output token costs. OpenAI reports Astra scoring 5.5 points above Claude Fable 5.2 on Agents' Last Exam at just 5% of the cost, plus a new high on Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1. The models ship first to ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API, not the standard chat mode.

Why it matters：头部实验室在竞对 IPO 前夜发布旗舰双模型，且以数量级成本优势对标，是当日最具注意力价值的事件。

item.title: Treg Open-Sources Jobs API for AI Agents at $0.03 per Hunt
item.description:
Treg has launched an open-source jobs API that lets AI agents search employer job boards, score fit against a resume and locate the hiring manager for a role. Fit scoring is handled by TypeSafe AI's decision model Jev at under $0.001 per evaluation, bringing a full job hunt to roughly $0.03 with no markup.

Why it matters：展示了决策模型在求职智能体中的低成本落地路径，对构建垂直 Agent 的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Latent Lattice Language Models Cut KV Cache 45% with 22 Layers
item.description:
The paper introduces Latent Lattice Language Models (LLLM), which add a horizontal latent width alongside the vertical residual-stream width. At 20B-token pretraining scale, LLLM matches a 40-layer Transformer's validation perplexity using only 22 layers, cutting KV cache by 45%, and can be combined with a Jacobi refiner for further gains.

原文标题：LLLM 架构以 22 层实现 45% KV 缓存缩减

Why it matters：提出新的残差流增强架构并在 20B token 规模验证，对关注大模型结构效率的读者有实质参考价值。

item.title: Nvidia Quarterly Revenue Doubles to $115.8 Billion on AI Data Center Demand
item.description:
Nvidia's quarterly revenue more than doubled year over year to $115.8 billion, with AI data centers accounting for 93% of the total and data center revenue up 110% to $107.6 billion. Vera Rubin NVL72 racks began shipping to CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Oracle, while AI cloud and enterprise sales nearly tripled to $47.5 billion, growing almost three times faster than hyperscalers. The $130 billion fourth-quarter guidance assumes no China data center compute sales.

原文标题：英伟达季度营收翻倍至 1158 亿美元

Why it matters：营收翻倍、Vera Rubin 新平台开始出货与 AI 云客户增速反超超大规模云厂商，是算力需求结构变化的关键信号。

item.title: Nvidia Faces SEC Civil Probe After CEO Huang's Departure
item.description:
The SEC has opened a civil probe into whether Nvidia's disclosures misled investors, following CEO Jensen Huang's resignation amid an extramarital affair involving an alleged Chinese spy. The investigation compounds Commerce Department scrutiny of chip diversion through Megaspeed and congressional pressure, with Nvidia shares down over 10% since Huang's exit even as quarterly revenue hit $115.8 billion, up 103% year over year.

Why it matters：全球市值最高芯片公司遭遇监管调查与 CEO 离职双重冲击，直接牵动 AI 算力供应链与出口管制走向。

item.title: Nvidia Posts $115.8B Quarterly Revenue as Data Center Sales Double
item.description:
Nvidia reported fiscal Q3 2027 revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year over year and above its $108 billion guidance, joining the small club of companies to top $100 billion in a single quarter. Data center revenue reached $107.6 billion, up 110%, while edge computing including consumer gaming brought in $8.2 billion, up 42%. Interim CEO Colette Kress did not initially address former CEO Jensen Huang's departure or a possible return, topics likely to surface on the analyst call.

原文标题：英伟达 Q3 营收 1158 亿美元 数据中心翻倍

Why it matters：英伟达单季营收首破千亿美元且数据中心同比翻倍，是 AI 算力需求景气度的关键风向标。

item.title: SEC Opens Civil Investigation Into Nvidia Disclosures to Investors
item.description:
The SEC has opened a civil investigation into whether Nvidia's disclosures misled investors, with scrutiny centering on a reporting change: Singapore billings reached $10.2B, or 22% of revenue, in the quarter ended July 2025, after which Nvidia stopped breaking out that region, saying chips almost always ship elsewhere. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent gave the board and outside counsel 10 days to explain whether the company pushed 'seemingly illicit sales' to lift earnings.

原文标题：美 SEC 对英伟达信息披露展开民事调查

Why it matters：监管调查叠加收入确认口径争议，直接触及英伟达财务披露可信度这一核心变量。

item.title: Nvidia Posts $183.3B Nine-Month Profit, Up 138% Year on Year
item.description:
Nvidia reported $293.68B in revenue and $183.30B in net income for the first nine months of fiscal 2027, up 98.69% and 137.72% year on year, with gross margin rising to 74.9%. Third-quarter revenue reached $115.84B and net income $65.29B, both roughly doubling year on year, underscoring still-accelerating AI compute demand.

原文标题：英伟达前三季净利 1833 亿美元 同比增 138%

Why it matters：这是 AI 算力景气度最直接的财务刻度，营收与利润翻倍增长为基础设施投资周期提供了硬数据。

item.title: Harvard Study Finds AI Coding Agents Shift Bottleneck to Code Review
item.description:
A Harvard working paper covering 718 firms finds that engineers using AI coding agents produced about 30% more code, yet completed work did not measurably increase and code took 49% longer to pass review. The authors argue the bottleneck has shifted from drafting to human review, and recommend measuring approved output, revision rates and reviewer time rather than raw code volume.

原文标题：哈佛研究：AI 编程代理使代码评审成新瓶颈

Why it matters：用 718 家企业的实证数据揭示 AI 编程代理的真实收益边界，对评估与部署 AI 编码工具具有直接参考价值。

item.title: Altman Says OpenAI Uses AI to Speed Up Next Model Development
item.description:
In a Semafor interview, Sam Altman confirmed that OpenAI uses its own models to accelerate development of next-generation models, an early form of recursive self-improvement (RSI). He explicitly denied any push-button, fully autonomous self-improvement loop, saying the company could lean further into RSI but cannot do so safely today.

原文标题：Altman 称 OpenAI 已用 AI 加速研发新模型

Why it matters：OpenAI 掌门人首次较明确地界定 RSI 的实际使用边界，是观察前沿实验室研发范式与安全取舍的一手表态。

item.title: Cutting Generative AI Costs by Replacing Model Calls with Rules
item.description:
An AWS blog post argues that the biggest cost lever in generative AI systems is whether a model is called at all, since deterministic steps such as input validation, formatting and routing can be handled by rule-based code. It offers a decision framework mapping each workflow step to deterministic code, a constrained decision call, or a right-sized model on Amazon Bedrock, and recommends starting with one high-volume workflow to measure how much of it never needed a model.

原文标题：用规则替代模型调用可大幅削减生成式 AI 成本

Why it matters：提供可落地的成本优化决策框架，对构建生产级 AI 系统的工程团队有直接参考价值。

AWS Machine Learning Blog · tools · signal 52/100

item.title: Amazon SageMaker Adds KV Cache-Aware Routing for Real-Time Endpoints
item.description:
Amazon SageMaker AI introduced KV cache-aware routing for real-time endpoints, using cache state reported by the model container to send each request to an instance holding a long cached prefix match that is not overloaded. It targets multi-turn chat, long shared prompts and RAG workloads, and is enabled via one environment variable plus the KV_AWARE routing strategy in the endpoint configuration, with no client API changes.

原文标题：SageMaker 实时端点新增 KV 缓存感知路由

Why it matters：这是云厂商推理底座在缓存复用调度上的实用工程更新，对部署 LLM 服务的团队有直接降本增效价值。

item.title: Critical OpenJDK Base64 Decoder Flaw Enables Remote Code Execution
item.description:
Researchers disclosed Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938), a memory-corruption vulnerability in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder rated 9.2 CRITICAL under CVSS 4.0. The flaw lies in the optimized x86-64 SIMD code path used to accelerate decoding and can lead to remote code execution. Given Java's position as the third most popular language and its role in 90% of Fortune 500 companies, the impact spans banking, aviation and telecom infrastructure, making patching urgent.

原文标题：OpenJDK Base64 解码器曝 9.2 分严重漏洞

Why it matters：影响面极广的 OpenJDK 远程代码执行漏洞，所有 Java 服务端与关键基础设施运维方都需立即评估。

Hacker News AI · opensource · signal 78/100

item.title: Australia Launches Agentaus 1, a 220B Sovereign AI Model
item.description:
Australian firm Trellis Data has released Agentaus 1, a 220B-parameter model built around data sovereignty: prompts stay on Australian servers and are never used for training. The company reports 84.4% on MMLU-Pro, ranking 43rd among foundation models, and says it runs on two GPUs where comparable models need four.

原文标题：澳大利亚推出 220B 参数主权大模型 Agentaus 1

Why it matters：这是主权 AI 与中等规模模型效率优化的结合案例，对关注区域化部署和推理成本的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Tencent Releases Hy4 Flash With 12B Active Parameters and 90% Price Cut
item.description:
Tencent introduces Hy4 flash, the most cost-efficient model in its Hy family, with 224B total parameters (including 64B Engram parameters) and only 12B active per token, natively multimodal with a 1M-token context window. API output pricing drops to $0.281 per million tokens, roughly one-ninth of Hy4; the architecture combines hybrid attention, LatentMoE and Engram to shrink KV cache to 1/24 of Hy3, while self-distillation and reinforcement learning cut end-to-end output tokens by 50%.

原文标题：腾讯发布 Hy4 flash 激活参数仅 12B 降价 90%

Why it matters：以 12B 激活参数实现接近 Hy4 的能力并将 API 价格压至九分之一，是稀疏 MoE 降本路线的重要工程样本。

item.title: GPT-6.2 Astra Tops AA-3D Interactive 3D Benchmark
item.description:
Artificial Analysis reports that GPT-6.2 Astra ranks first on AA-3D, its benchmark for building interactive 3D experiences, winning 139 of 152 human head-to-head votes. The result signals that spatial and interactive content generation is now being folded into standardized frontier-model evaluation.

原文标题：GPT-6.2 Astra 登顶 AA-3D 交互式 3D 生成榜

Why it matters：首个针对交互式 3D 生成的公开人类偏好榜单结果，反映前沿模型能力评测的新维度。

item.title: 零数据留存取决于 API 设计而非厂商承诺
item.description:
Fireworks AI CEO Lin Qiao 指出，AI 基础设施中的“零数据留存”常被误解，实际取决于 API 设计：客户管理型（上传、使用、删除）与临时处理型（发送、计算、返回）。批处理 API 如 OpenAI、Bedrock、Gemini 采用前者，数据留存至用户删除；推理 API 如 Chat Completions 采用后者。两种设计下客户均掌握控制权，但临时处理在流程允许时更优，可避免遗忘数据集与遗漏删除调用。

Why it matters：厘清了企业采购 AI 服务时最易混淆的数据留存概念，并给出可操作的 API 选型判断框架。

Marktechpost (@Marktechpost) · compute · signal 58/100

item.title: 微软 Ignite 发布三款新模型并同步上线 OpenRouter
item.description:
微软在 Ignite 大会上发布三款新模型，并同步上线 OpenRouter。MAI-Image-2.7 支持 2K 分辨率与透明背景生成，Flash 版本面向高吞吐场景；Microsoft-Decision-1.1 可在单次调用中为每个选项输出校准后的概率。

Why it matters：微软新模型发布并即时开放第三方平台调用，对关注模型选型与图像生成的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Perplexity 年化收入破 10 亿美元 烧钱仅为 Anthropic 五分之一
item.description:
Perplexity 年化收入运行率已突破 10 亿美元，创始人 Aravind Srinivas 称 2026 年初该数字还不足 2.5 亿美元，8 月已超 7.5 亿美元。其低烧钱率源于结构性选择：不自研前沿基座模型，而是将任务路由至 Claude、GPT 与 Gemini，用户只关心任务是否完成。对比 Anthropic 的 S-1 文件，其达到约 10 亿美元收入耗费了 73 亿美元经营现金。

Why it matters：以收入与烧钱对比揭示“不自研基座、做模型路由”这一商业路径的可行性，对判断 AI 应用层与模型层格局有实质参考价值。

item.title: AWS Agent Registry 新增自定义元数据架构
item.description:
AWS Agent Registry 推出自定义元数据架构，允许管理员为智能体、MCP 服务器与技能记录定义统一的键值属性，并强制应用于全组织记录。该能力解决了此前无法在注册表中定义和存储组织专属事实（如业务单元、负责人、风险分级）的问题，使审批与检索更可靠。

Why it matters：这是云厂商注册表产品的一次治理能力补齐，对使用 AWS 构建智能体资产目录的团队有实际参考价值。

item.description:
OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 GPT-6.2 Sol 两款新模型，前者面向科学、法律、金融等高强度专业任务，后者主打日常快速响应，API 价格较前代下调 20%。在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上 Astra 位列第二，仅次于 Claude Fable 5.2，但在性价比帕累托前沿上占据优势。
